extracted.name: Air fryer French fries
extracted.description: Use an air-fryer instead of the oven to save energy costs when cooking any kind of frozen chips. Enjoy with your favourite sauces
instruction_lines: Heat the air-fryer to 200C. Put the frozen French fries into the air-fryer basket and cook for 5 mins. Toss the fries then cook for another 5 mins before tossing again and cooking for another 5-10 mins until crisp and golden (the exact cooking time will depend on the size of your air-fryer). Season and serve with your favourite sauces, if you like
